summary: Broadcom Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the launch of cash tender offers for up to $2.5 billion aggregate purchase price of six series of its outstanding senior notes (e.g., 4.926% due 2037, 4.900% due 2038). Consideration is based on fixed spreads over U.S. Treasury benchmarks (70-110 bps) plus accrued interest. Broadcom is the issuer purchasing its own debt. The offers are subject to a consideration cap and acceptance priority levels; no advisor or board recommendation is stated. The transaction is a debt liability management exercise. Watch for proration and whether Broadcom increases the cap; risk-arb is minimal as this is a pure capital structure optimization.
